title: A Journey cannot go live empty or untitled from any publish button, and a refused publish says why

source.ref: Journey audit 2026-11-17 (project thread: Dial in the Journey Wizard and Journeys)

detail: The guide's Ready checklist (readyCheck / readyToPublish in lib/journeys/wizard.ts: a real name, and phases with steps inside) was enforced only in the guide's client. The editor header's Publish, the settings visibility control, the learn page's author Publish and the manage card all called setJourneyVisibility directly, which never ran it, so a fresh draft (createJourneyDraftAction seeds three empty phases) could be listed in the library with nothing to start (the detail page hides Start when there are no lessons). The settings control and the learn-page button also swallowed a refused publish. Fixed 2026-11-17: lib/journeys/publish-ready.ts checkJourneyReadyToPublish runs the same pure checklist over the stored row and block counts, and setJourneyVisibility refuses public or unlisted with the failing item's words ('Before it goes live: ...'); going back to private never needs it. The settings hook (shared with the Inspector rail) and the learn-page author actions now show the refusal. Live data note 2026-11-17: the public Wildheart Year has 12 phases and 12 modules but no lessons, so it would be refused if re-published until steps are added (it stays live as is). Guarded by lib/journeys/publish-ready.test.ts.

verify.note: Fails if setJourneyVisibility stops running checkJourneyReadyToPublish, that check stops using the guide's readyToPublish, or the settings or learn-page publish controls swallow a refusal.
